## Description

Staff app: work email + passkey or code, choose facility, Face ID / fingerprint unlock after a 15-minute lock with PIN fallback and switch user, Today with next patient hero, queue with tokens and 'via app' marks, privacy-safe patient search, patient summary (allergy never by colour alone), offline banner with read-only last copy, role-based tabs (5 maximum). Same capabilities and care-relationship rules as the web app, enforced by the API.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the app is idle for 15 minutes, when it is opened again, then it asks for Face ID, fingerprint or PIN before showing anything.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a receptionist signs in, when the tabs load, then clinical-only tabs are absent and their API calls return 403.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the phone is offline, when the doctor opens Today, then the last copy shows with an offline banner and no edit action.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a patient has an allergy, when the summary opens, then the allergy shows as text and icon, not colour alone.
- [ ] **AC5.** Given the staff app is open, when someone takes a screenshot, then Android blocks it and iOS blurs the app switcher and audits the screenshot (ADR-011 §6).
- [ ] **AC6.** Given the phone is revoked or the user switches, when the app next talks to the server, then the encrypted store is wiped and nothing of the previous user remains (ADR-011 §3, §5).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
